claude.summary: Markets Extension for Command Palette is a Windows 11 PowerToys Command Palette extension for stock, crypto and currency data, using a Twelve Data or Finnhub API key; it is on the Microsoft Store and WinGet. This covers the "cmd palette stocks extension" idea noted on 10 Apr and 20 Jun.
